 Blue Bloods’ Major Reagan Family Member Return Officially Unveiled
 Closeup of Donnie Wahlberg as Danny Reagan in Boston Blue Image via MovieStillsDB 
 By  
 Matthew Rudoy 
 Published Oct 19, 2026, 5:36 PM EDT 
 Matthew Rudoy is one of ScreenRant 's Movie & TV News Editors. He covers the latest in movie & TV news, with a focus on major franchises like Star Wars , The Boys , and Game of Thrones , and also writes some features and reviews.  A major Reagan family member is officially back in Boston Blue . 
 After the end of Blue Bloods , Danny Reagan (Donnie Wahlberg) went on to get his own spinoff series set in Boston. Other characters from the original series who have appeared in the spinoff include Danny's son Sean Reagan, now played by Mika Amonsen instead of Andrew Terraciano, Danny's sister-in-law, Erin Reagan (Bridget Moynahan), and Danny's grandfather, Henry Reagan (Len Cariou). 
 Paramount Plus has now revealed that Danny's brother, Jamie Reagan (Will Estes), will be in Boston Blue season 2, episode 5, "Blood Diamonds." The episode has Jamie visiting Boston, only for the visit to be impacted by a diamond heist that tests the brothers' own unresolved tension. Check out the images below:

 The episode will also feature Lena Silver (Sonequa Martin-Green) investigating a series of deaths connected to a parishioner of Reverend Edwin Peters (Ernie Hudson), Mae Silver (Gloria Reuben) facing a case of her own involving swatting leading to a man's death, and Sarah Silver (Maggie Lawson) and Seth Yates (Mike Vogel) encountering a surprising challenge while planning their wedding. 
 While Danny and Sean are series regulars in the Boston Blue cast , the other members of the Reagan family who appear tend to do so in a guest-starring capacity, which is the case with Jamie's appearance. Most of the other series regular characters are members of the Silver family, with Lena working alongside Danny in the Boston Police Department, Mae as the Boston District Attorney, and Sarah as Boston PD's Superintendent of Detectives. Sean is a Boston patrol officer partnered with Jonah Silver (Marcus Scribner), Mae's son and younger half-brother to Sarah and Lena. 
 "Blood Diamonds" has plenty going on with the Silver family, but the reunion between Danny and Jamie will be the biggest draw for Blue Bloods fans, especially since this is the latter's first appearance in the spinoff. Unresolved tension resurfacing between the brothers also brings the possibility of more major Blue Bloods connections coming this episode, rewarding longtime viewers of the original CBS procedural.

 Boston Blue season 1 reviews were generally positive, with ScreenRant 's Ana Dumaraog giving it eight out of 10 stars, and the series receiving an overall score of 82% from critics on Rotten Tomatoes. The audience reception was much less favorable at 32%, though. There are no scores for season 2 as of this writing, but by comparison, Blue Bloods had an overall audience score of 83% and no calculated critics' score. 
 Brandon Sonnier and Brandon Margolis are the creators, showrunners, and executive producers of Boston Blue and developed the story for season 2, episode 5. The episode is directed by Monica Raymund, who previously directed an episode of season 1, along with episodes of Law & Order: SVU , Law & Order: Organized Crime , The Sinner , National Treasure: Edge of History , FBI , Power Book II: Ghost , Dexter: Original Sin , Power Book III: Raising Kanan , Dexter: Resurrection , and Power Book IV: Force . As an actor, she starred in Blue Bloods season 2, episode 3. 
 Boston Blue season 2, episode 5, "Blood Diamonds" airs Friday, November 6 at 10:00 p.m. ET on CBS.
